name: Google AI Studio
summary: Google's tool for prototyping with Gemini models.

flows.title: Create a chat prompt with system instructions
steps: Open Google AI Studio. The Playground opens by default with a new chat prompt.
Click Run settings in the top right corner to expand the panel, and find the System Instructions input field.
Paste the instructions the model should follow into the System Instructions field.
In the text input box labelled Type something, enter a question a user might ask.
Click Run to get a response from the model.
To adjust the model's tone or the length of its answers, edit the System Instructions and run the question again. System instructions can be modified after the chat has started.
